clinical_intent: I am performing a quality assurance check on the CT simulation for brachytherapy planning. I need to verify: (1) CT number accuracy using a phantom, (2) geometric accuracy of the CT images, (3) the effect of contrast material on CT-based dose calculation, and (4) the appropriate CT-to-electron-density conversion table for brachytherapy applicators. How do I perform each of these QA checks?
